notes.title: Extended version of out demo is out!
notes.notes: [p]Hello, Talewardens![/p][p][/p][p]We just released the extended version of the demo![/p][p]Now, in the demo you can play the first half of Act I and interact with the journal, which summarises information about the mysteries and characters you discover. The demo also contains point-and-click elements, a travel mechanic, and a campfire where you can talk and bond with your companions.[/p][p][/p][p]We've also prepared a short survey where you can share your experience with the demo. We'd really appreciate your feedback![/p][p][url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdDizssX_s9q9mvFrC9Ad8xSVRW343Rbemob97Xqwq58UKJpg/viewform"][b]Feedback form[/b][/url][/p]

notes.title: Big dev update and happy pride! 🏳️‍🌈
notes.notes: [h2][b]Hello Talewardens![/b][/h2][p][/p][h3]Act II is almost finished![/h3][p]Now in Act II, you will be able to visit 13 locations, talk to your companions at 5 campfires, and watch a shadow puppet show at one of them. We have created 12 new backgrounds, 6 new CGs, 4 new characters' sprites and updated 4 old ones, and made many additional graphics. All that's left to do is to add an extra place to visit (which may or may not lead to your kidnapping later 😉) and make final adjustments.[/p][p]After that, we will revise Act I and start working on Act III![/p][p][/p][p]Here's an example of recent changes. Some sprites, like Daydra's, received minor updates, while others, like Puna's, underwent total redesigns:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246997/5ffabe35aeeabfc8fdd7dc5f4bfe9a4185491f92.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Take a sneak peek at Act II's scene where you meet Marjorie, a deer centaur who creates sculptures from her own clay-hair. She will try to help Finch (the statue guy) discover what he really wants: to be human. You can either promise to help him change or convince him that it’s better to remain a marble statue.[/p][previewyoutube="-NPEL8iq8mY;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]And since it's June, we want to wish everyone a happy Pride Month! To celebrate, we have created illustrations of our cowboys with their colors. ❤️🧡💛💚💙💜🤎🖤[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246997/d8271661a0ca91cd4b50668ed75998b3249435c1.png"][/img][/p][p]Thank you for your patience and support! We really appreciate feedback, so please don't hesitate to reach out.[/p][p]You can play demo of Talewarden: Riders of the New Day on Itch.io and Steam![/p][p]Do gay, be crime, Talewardens! 🏳️‍🌈[/p][p]—BucketHatCat Team[/p]

notes.title: Demo and development update!
notes.notes:
Hello Talewardens! 


We have changed some details in the demo to make it more similar to the final product, such as adding more expressions and sprite poses, and changing the text of some UI elements. We also added point-and-click elements you can interact with while exploring some locations in the game! 


We are currently working on Act II of the game. We expect the entire game to consist of three or four acts plus endings. We have almost finished the script, but there is still a lot of work to be done. We’ll keep you posted on any major developments!
